programs.title: Self Reliance
programs.desc: A man receives an offer to win $1 million by playing a game where he must outwit hunters who are trying to kill him. He soon realizes they can only attack him when he's alone, but none of his friends or family believe the game is real.

programs.title: Ferrari
programs.desc: During the summer of 1957, bankruptcy looms over the company that Enzo Ferrari and his wife built 10 years earlier. He decides to roll the dice and wager it all on the iconic Mille Miglia, a treacherous 1,000-mile race across Italy.

programs.title: Live and Let Die
programs.desc: When Bond (Roger Moore) investigates the murders of three fellow agents, he finds himself a target, evading vicious assassins as he closes in on powerful Kananga (Yaphet Kotto). Known on the streets as Mr. Big, Kananga is coordinating a global threat, using tons of self-produced heroin. As Bond tries to unravel the mastermind's plan, he meets Solitaire (Jane Seymour), a beautiful tarot-card reader, whose magic is crucial to the crime lord.

programs.title: A Zest for Death: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
programs.desc: Hannah Swensen is determined to get to the bottom of the mystery after her mother finds the dead body of a homeowner, and frequent patron of The Cookie Jar, while house-hunting for her sister Michelle.

programs.title: We Three Kings
programs.desc: A retired musician hatches a plan to bring his three daughters home for Christmas for the first time since their mother's death. Holiday songs and old memories soon make the estranged siblings realize that life is better when they're all together.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mysteries
programs.desc: When Jennifer agrees to appear on a reality TV series, she uncovers a puzzle box which may contain the clue to solving a murder.

programs.title: Shayda
programs.desc: Shayda, a brave Iranian mother, finds refuge in an Australian women's shelter with her six-year-old daughter, where they take solace in new beginnings. When the estranged husband and father re-enters their lives, Shayda's path to freedom is jeopardized.

programs.title: A Beautiful Place to Die: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery
programs.desc: After being forced into early retirement, former detective Jeff Jackson returns to a quiet life on Martha's Vineyard. Quiet, at least, until a body washes up, and he's drawn back into crime solving.

programs.title: Riddled With Deceit: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery
programs.desc: Former Detective Jeff Jackson teams up with Dr. Zee Madeiras to track down their friend's missing emerald brooch, a thief and a murderer.

programs.title: The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie
programs.desc: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck become Earth's only hope when their antics at the local bubble-gum factory uncover a secret alien mind-control plot. Faced with cosmic odds, they must save their town and the world while not driving each other totally loony.

programs.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programs.desc: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: Karen is tasked with playing an online phone game for Fitzy while Wanda and Hank settle a bet with mini putt.
